subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should this PR wait for live owner-session delivery proof, or may maintainers accept source-level tests/CI for the Telegram-visible completion path?
rationale: The code path is narrow, but the remaining blocker is proof sufficiency for a user-visible session/message-delivery change that automation cannot infer from unit tests alone.

options.title: Require Live Delivery Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

options.title: Accept Source-Level Proof
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge with source and regression-test evidence only, while owning the remaining real transport/session delivery risk.

options.title: Pause For Broader Contract
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want a single task-completion wake contract across background-task, exec, ACP, and subagent paths before landing targeted fixes.

recommendation.title: Require Live Delivery Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.
